name: Movies
overview: Scripture calls believers to guard their hearts and eyes diligently, recognizing that what we expose ourselves to influences our spiritual well-being and moral purity. The psalmist declares a rejection of wickedness and violence before the eyes, emphasizing a holy standard for what we allow to captivate us. Jesus teaches that a focused and pure vision fills the whole body with light, underscoring the importance of discerning what we watch, including movies. Given the presence of themes like horror and magic in films, believers are urged to avoid anything that defiles the heart or promotes evil, as what proceeds from within ultimately defines our spiritual condition.
